article.title: Duda整合電郵、短訊及自動化行銷，部分AI接入仍分階段推出
article.title_en: Duda brings email, SMS and marketing automation into its platform
article.summary: Duda於11月2日整理DudaCon更新，將網站製作延伸至客戶聯繫與行銷管理。
article.summary_en: Duda’s November 2 recap extends its website platform into customer communications.
highlights: 內建聯絡人管理及多步驟行銷流程。
部分AI接入仍在推出，不能視為全部帳戶已可用。
highlights_en: Contact management and multistep marketing workflows are included.
Some AI integrations are still rolling out.
article.why: 代客管理網站的團隊，可評估能否在同一平台接續處理查詢及客戶跟進。
article.why_en: Website agencies can assess whether lead follow-up fits their existing platform.
article.next_step: 先核對客戶方案的電郵、短訊與自動化額度，再比較現有工具。
article.next_step_en: Check each client plan’s messaging and automation allowances before comparing tools.
article.detail: Duda的行銷自動化功能把電郵、短訊、聯絡人資料及多步驟流程整合到網站平台。團隊可按觸發條件、等待時間及訊息設定跟進工作。官方亦公布新的網站方案，額度隨方案而異。AI Copilot及外部AI助理接入同步擴展，部分整合仍分階段推出。公告沒有證明轉換率或成本必然改善，採用前需核對帳戶資格與方案限制。
article.detail_en: Duda describes built-in messaging, contact management and workflows with triggers and delays. New site plans have different allowances. Expanded Copilot and external-assistant integrations have mixed rollout status; the announcement does not establish conversion gains or savings.
article.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
